sections.heading: Core built-ins
sections.markdown:
- `print(value)` — print with newline
- `dump(value)` — debug print with type info
- `typeOf(value)` — return a stable TypeId / `Type.xxx` value
- `typeName(value)` — return the debug/logging type name
- `x is T` — runtime type check with analyzer narrowing
- `i64(value)` / `f64(value)` / `string(value)` / `bool(value)` — explicit conversions
- `assert(cond, msg?)` / `assertEqual(a, b, msg?)` / `assertThrows(action, msg?)` / `assertPanics(action, msg?)` — testing assertions
- `len(array)` — the new-XIR Array subset returns i64 length without allocation or element traversal; lexical/imported functions named len retain ordinary binding, and other lengthable families require separate admission (spec §17.26).

sections.heading: Admitted XIR floating semantics
sections.markdown: New-XIR typed print accepts f32/f64 (spec section 17.27). Finite values use the shortest round-tripping decimal at their original precision, with an even final digit on equal-distance ties. Decimal exponents in [-4,16) use fixed notation (integral values end in .0); others use lowercase e and a signed exponent. Special spellings are nan, inf, -inf, 0.0 and -0.0. A complete output group is prepared before one sink call; insufficient budget, allocation failure and rejected output retain OUTPUT_ERROR cleanup semantics.
